core_public.title: Public money in the 30 current arenas
core_public.label: a
core_public.note: Construction, public purchases, completed or binding renovations, and yearly cash payments documented to date. Pending deals are not counted.
core_public.method: select sum(public_2026_m) from items where core

total_spending.title: All money spent on the 30 current arenas
total_spending.label: a
total_spending.note: Construction (public and private), renovations (public and private) and public yearly payments. Public purchases count as public money but not as new spending, since they pay back private builders.
total_spending.method: select sum(spending_2026_m) from items where core

public_share.title: Public share of all arena spending
public_share.label: a
public_share.method: select 100 * sum(public_2026_m) / sum(spending_2026_m) from items where core

construction_public.title: Public money for construction
construction_public.label: a
construction_public.method: select sum(public_2026_m) from items where core and kind = 'construction'

purchase_public.title: Public money to buy existing arenas
purchase_public.label: a
purchase_public.method: select sum(public_2026_m) from items where core and kind = 'purchase'

renovation_public.title: Public money for completed or binding renovations
renovation_public.label: a
renovation_public.method: select sum(public_2026_m) from items where core and kind = 'renovation'

ongoing_public.title: Yearly public payments to teams or arena operators, documented to date
ongoing_public.basis: 2026 dollars, each payment at its year
ongoing_public.label: a
ongoing_public.method: select sum(public_2026_m) from items where core and kind = 'ongoing'

ongoing_teams.title: Teams with documented yearly public payments
ongoing_teams.label: a
ongoing_teams.method: select count(distinct team) from items where core and kind = 'ongoing'

expanded_public.title: Public money including property-tax breaks and taxes diverted to arena debt
expanded_public.label: a
expanded_public.note: Adds Barclays Center's PILOT bonds, Madison Square Garden's property-tax exemption since 1982 and the United Center's valuation formula, 2002-2016. A floor, because the Garden's exemption is a nominal sum and the United Center's 1994-2001 years could not be computed.
expanded_public.method: select (select sum(public_2026_m) from items where core) + sum(coalesce(pilot_2026_m, 0)) + sum(case when tax_break_in_expanded_total = 'Y' then tax_break_cumulative_2026_m else 0 end) from arenas

expanded_share.title: Public share with tax breaks added to both sides
expanded_share.label: a
expanded_share.note: The PILOT bonds already sit inside Barclays Center's construction cost, so only the other breaks are added to the spending base.
expanded_share.method: select 100 * ((select sum(public_2026_m) from items where core) + sum(coalesce(pilot_2026_m, 0)) + sum(case when tax_break_in_expanded_total = 'Y' then tax_break_cumulative_2026_m else 0 end)) / ((select sum(spending_2026_m) from items where core) + sum(case when tax_break_in_expanded_total = 'Y' then tax_break_cumulative_2026_m else 0 end)) from arenas

top10_share.title: Share of public money in the 10 arenas with the most
top10_share.label: a
top10_share.method: with t as (select team, sum(public_2026_m) p from items where core group by team order by p desc limit 10) select 100 * sum(p) / (select sum(public_2026_m) from items where core) from t

top_n.title: Arenas in the top group
top_n.label: a
top_n.note: The size of the group in top10_share.

orl_public.title: Public money in Orlando's Kia Center, the most of any arena
orl_public.label: a
orl_public.method: select sum(public_2026_m) from items where core and team = 'ORL'

orl_share.title: Public share of all spending on the Kia Center
orl_share.label: a
orl_share.method: select 100 * sum(public_2026_m) / sum(spending_2026_m) from items where core and team = 'ORL'

costliest_private_n.title: The costliest arenas, in a row, that were built mainly with private money
costliest_private_n.label: a
costliest_private_n.note: Arenas ranked by construction cost in 2026 dollars; Intuit Dome, Chase Center, Barclays Center, Little Caesars Arena and Madison Square Garden.
costliest_private_n.method: with r as (select team, built_privately_majority = 'Y' as p, row_number() over (order by construction_cost_2026_m desc) as rn from arenas) select min(rn) - 1 from r where not p

private_built_n.title: Arenas built mainly with private money
private_built_n.label: a
private_built_n.note: Public money was under half of the construction cost.
private_built_n.method: select count(*) from arenas where built_privately_majority = 'Y'

rebuild_since_2014.title: Public money to renovate or buy existing arenas since 2014
rebuild_since_2014.label: a
rebuild_since_2014.note: Completed or binding. Renovations at their mid-construction year, work still under way at face value, purchases at the purchase year.
rebuild_since_2014.method: select sum(public_2026_m) from items where core and kind in ('renovation', 'purchase') and year >= 2014

build_since_2014.title: Public money in the arenas that opened since 2014
build_since_2014.label: a
build_since_2014.note: Sacramento (2016), Detroit (2017) and Milwaukee (2018), at their opening years. Intuit Dome (2024) had no public construction money.
build_since_2014.method: select sum(public_2026_m) from items where core and kind = 'construction' and year >= 2014

rebuild_ratio.title: Rebuilding money as a multiple of building money, since 2014
rebuild_ratio.label: a
rebuild_ratio.method: select (select sum(public_2026_m) from items where core and kind in ('renovation', 'purchase') and year >= 2014) / (select sum(public_2026_m) from items where core and kind = 'construction' and year >= 2014)

opened_public_since_2014.title: Arenas opened since 2014 with public construction money
opened_public_since_2014.label: a
opened_public_since_2014.method: select count(*) from items where core and kind = 'construction' and year >= 2014 and public_2026_m > 0

rebuild_arenas_since_2014.title: Existing arenas that got public money to renovate or buy them since 2014
rebuild_arenas_since_2014.label: a
rebuild_arenas_since_2014.method: select count(distinct team) from items where core and kind in ('renovation', 'purchase') and year >= 2014 and public_2026_m > 0

pending_existing.title: Public money pending for current arenas
pending_existing.label: a
pending_existing.note: Memphis and Portland. Not counted in the totals.
pending_existing.method: select sum(public_2026_m) from items where kind = 'renovation' and status = 'pending'

new_arenas_committed.title: Public money committed to new arenas not yet open
new_arenas_committed.label: a
new_arenas_committed.note: Oklahoma City's replacement arena (binding) and Bexar County's voter-approved share of a San Antonio arena. Outside the 30-arena totals.
new_arenas_committed.method: select sum(public_2026_m) from items where kind = 'project' and team in ('OKC', 'SAS') and status <> 'pending'

okc_new_arena.title: Public money for Oklahoma City's replacement arena
okc_new_arena.label: a/b/c ; b/c
okc_new_arena.method: select public_2026_m from items where item_id = 'OKC-project'

sas_county.title: Bexar County's voter-approved money for a new Spurs arena
sas_county.label: c
sas_county.method: select public_2026_m from items where item_id = 'SAS-project'

sas_pending.title: San Antonio city money for a new Spurs arena, pending
sas_pending.label: c
sas_pending.method: select public_2026_m from items where item_id = 'SAS-project-pending'

uta_district.title: Salt Lake City sales-tax money for the district around the Delta Center
uta_district.label: b/c
uta_district.method: select public_2026_m from items where item_id = 'UTA-project'

uta_arena_2025.title: Salt Lake City sales-tax money for the Delta Center renovation
uta_arena_2025.label: b/c
uta_arena_2025.method: select public_2026_m from items where item_id = 'UTA-renovation-3'

slc_sales_tax_rate.title: Salt Lake City sales tax that pays for the Delta Center deal
slc_sales_tax_rate.label: b
slc_sales_tax_rate.method: Entered by hand; confirmed against data/ledger/ledger_items.csv (item_id=UTA-renovation-3, column desc: "0.5% city sales tax")

was_2024_deal.title: DC money to buy and renovate Capital One Arena under the 2024 deal
was_2024_deal.label: b/a
was_2024_deal.note: $87.5 million purchase (2024) and $427.5 million renovation (face value).
was_2024_deal.method: select sum(public_2026_m) from items where item_id in ('WAS-purchase', 'WAS-renovation-2')

was_purchase.title: DC purchase of Capital One Arena
was_purchase.label: b/a
was_purchase.method: select public_2026_m from items where item_id = 'WAS-purchase'

orl_2024.title: Orange County tourist-tax money for the Kia Center renovation
orl_2024.label: c
orl_2024.method: select public_2026_m from items where item_id = 'ORL-renovation-1'

hou_2026.title: State of Texas grant for the Toyota Center renovation
hou_2026.label: c
hou_2026.method: select public_2026_m from items where item_id = 'HOU-renovation-1'

mem_state_2025.title: Tennessee money allocated to the FedExForum renovation
mem_state_2025.label: c/a
mem_state_2025.method: select public_2026_m from items where item_id = 'MEM-renovation-1'

mem_pending.title: Public money for the FedExForum renovation held until a new lease is signed
mem_pending.label: c
mem_pending.method: select public_2026_m from items where item_id = 'MEM-renovation-2'

mem_renovation_cost.title: Cost of the FedExForum renovation
mem_renovation_cost.label: c
mem_renovation_cost.method: select sum(spending_nominal_m) from items where item_id in ('MEM-renovation-1', 'MEM-renovation-2')

por_pending.title: Pending public money to rebuild the Moda Center
por_pending.label: b
por_pending.note: State of Oregon up to $365 million, Multnomah County up to $88 million, City of Portland up to $120 million.
por_pending.method: select sum(public_2026_m) from items where team = 'POR' and kind = 'renovation' and status = 'pending'

por_state.title: State of Oregon bonds for the Moda Center, repaid from income taxes withheld at the arena
por_state.label: b
por_state.method: select public_2026_m from items where item_id = 'POR-renovation-1'

takeover_n.title: Arenas built mainly with private money that were later bought or rebuilt with public money
takeover_n.label: a
takeover_n.method: select count(distinct i.team) from items i join arenas a using (team) where a.built_privately_majority = 'Y' and i.kind in ('renovation', 'purchase') and (i.core or i.status = 'pending') and i.public_2026_m > 0

takeover_public.title: Public money to buy or rebuild arenas built mainly with private money
takeover_public.basis: 2026 dollars; pending money at face value
takeover_public.label: a
takeover_public.method: select sum(i.public_2026_m) from items i join arenas a using (team) where a.built_privately_majority = 'Y' and i.kind in ('renovation', 'purchase') and (i.core or i.status = 'pending')

takeover_pending.title: Of that, pending
takeover_pending.label: a
takeover_pending.method: select sum(i.public_2026_m) from items i join arenas a using (team) where a.built_privately_majority = 'Y' and i.kind = 'renovation' and i.status = 'pending'

takeover_construction_public.title: Public money in the construction of those arenas
takeover_construction_public.label: a
takeover_construction_public.method: select sum(i.public_2026_m) from items i join arenas a using (team) where a.built_privately_majority = 'Y' and i.kind = 'construction' and i.team in (select team from items where kind in ('renovation', 'purchase') and (core or status = 'pending') and public_2026_m > 0)

residents_share.title: Share of public capital from taxes residents mostly pay
residents_share.label: a
residents_share.note: General funds and general-obligation bonds, dedicated sales taxes, tax increment and other tax capture, lease-revenue bonds, and alcohol and tobacco taxes.
residents_share.method: select 100 * sum(b.public_2026_m) / (select sum(public_2026_m) from capital) from buckets b join capital c using (item_id) join bucket_groups g using (bucket) where g.payer = 'residents'

visitors_share.title: Share of public capital from taxes on visitors
visitors_share.label: a
visitors_share.note: Taxes on hotel rooms, car rentals, restaurant food and drink, and tickets.
visitors_share.method: select 100 * sum(b.public_2026_m) / (select sum(public_2026_m) from capital) from buckets b join capital c using (item_id) join bucket_groups g using (bucket) where g.payer = 'visitors'

other_share.title: Share of public capital given as land, or with no documented funding stream
other_share.label: a
other_share.method: select 100 * sum(b.public_2026_m) / (select sum(public_2026_m) from capital) from buckets b join capital c using (item_id) join bucket_groups g using (bucket) where g.payer = 'other'

visitors_public.title: Public capital from taxes on visitors
visitors_public.label: a
visitors_public.method: select sum(b.public_2026_m) from buckets b join capital c using (item_id) join bucket_groups g using (bucket) where g.payer = 'visitors'

hh_uta.title: Salt Lake City's Delta Center deal per household in the city
hh_uta.basis: 2026 dollars per household; an upper bound
hh_uta.label: a
hh_uta.note: The arena's $525 million and the district's $375 million, over the city's households. People who live elsewhere pay part of the city's sales tax, so this is an upper bound.
hh_uta.method: select per_household_2026 from households where team = 'UTA' and share = 1

hh_okc.title: Oklahoma City's arena money per household in the city
hh_okc.label: a
hh_okc.note: The replacement arena and 2025 bond projects tied to it, plus the money for Paycom Center in 2002 and 2008.
hh_okc.method: select per_household_2026 from households where team = 'OKC' and share = 1

hh_was.title: DC's money for Capital One Arena since 1997, per household
hh_was.label: a
hh_was.method: select per_household_2026 from households where team = 'WAS' and share = 1

nyk_exemption.title: Madison Square Garden's property-tax exemption since 1982
nyk_exemption.basis: nominal sum, a floor in 2026 dollars
nyk_exemption.label: c
nyk_exemption.note: Reinvent Albany's sum of the Independent Budget Office's yearly estimates.
nyk_exemption.method: select tax_break_cumulative_2026_m from arenas where team = 'NYK'

nyk_exemption_fy2023.title: Madison Square Garden's exemption in fiscal 2023
nyk_exemption_fy2023.label: b
nyk_exemption_fy2023.method: select tax_break_annual_m from arenas where team = 'NYK'

bkn_pilot.title: Barclays Center PILOT bonds, repaid with property taxes diverted to arena debt
bkn_pilot.label: b/a
bkn_pilot.note: $511 million issued in 2009, converted at the 2012 opening year.
bkn_pilot.method: select pilot_2026_m from arenas where team = 'BKN'

chi_formula.title: Property tax the United Center did not pay under the 1989 formula, 2002-2016
chi_formula.label: a
chi_formula.method: select tax_break_cumulative_2026_m from arenas where team = 'CHI'

chi_formula_nominal.title: The same, in the dollars of each year
chi_formula_nominal.label: a

uc_formula_bill_min.title: Lowest United Center tax bill under the formula, 2002-2016
uc_formula_bill_min.label: b/a
uc_formula_bill_min.note: The statute's $1 million minimum applied in 2005-2008.

uc_formula_bill_max.title: Highest United Center tax bill under the formula, 2002-2016
uc_formula_bill_max.label: b

uc_normal_min.title: Lowest estimated bill without the formula, 2002-2016
uc_normal_min.label: a
uc_normal_min.note: The first assessed value after the formula ended, at each year's equalization factor and tax rate.

uc_normal_max.title: Highest estimated bill without the formula, 2002-2016
uc_normal_max.label: a

uc_after_min.title: Lowest United Center tax bill after the formula ended, 2017-2024
uc_after_min.label: b

uc_after_max.title: Highest United Center tax bill after the formula ended, 2017-2024
uc_after_max.label: b

was_exemption_future.title: Value of DC's property-tax exemption for Capital One Arena, fiscal 2025-2050
was_exemption_future.basis: future years, as valued by DC's chief financial officer
was_exemption_future.label: b
was_exemption_future.note: $49.8 million for fiscal 2025-2028 and $262.9 million for fiscal 2029-2050 (Table 1). Not added to any total.
was_exemption_future.method: select tax_break_future_committed_m from arenas where team = 'WAS'

den_seat_tax_memo.title: Ball Arena's exemption from Denver's seat tax, 1999-2023 (memo)
den_seat_tax_memo.label: c
den_seat_tax_memo.note: Not added to any total; the press figure could not be opened.
den_seat_tax_memo.method: select tax_break_memo_estimate_m from arenas where team = 'DEN'

fed_bond_cost.title: Federal cost of tax-exempt arena bonds
fed_bond_cost.basis: present value at issue, in 2026 dollars
fed_bond_cost.label: a
fed_bond_cost.note: New-money bond issues only, at a 28 percent marginal tax rate (the Gayer, Drukker and Gold method). Paid by all U.S. taxpayers; not added to any total.

tax_breaks_added.title: Tax breaks added to the expanded total
tax_breaks_added.label: a
tax_breaks_added.method: select (select sum(coalesce(pilot_2026_m, 0)) from arenas) + (select sum(tax_break_cumulative_2026_m) from arenas where tax_break_in_expanded_total = 'Y')

ind_ongoing.title: Capital Improvement Board payments to the Pacers, documented
ind_ongoing.label: b/a
ind_ongoing.method: select sum(public_2026_m) from items where team = 'IND' and kind = 'ongoing'

ind_yearly_min.title: Smallest yearly payment to the Pacers, 2015-2025
ind_yearly_min.label: b
ind_yearly_min.method: select min(v) from (select year, sum(public_nominal_m) v from items where team = 'IND' and kind = 'ongoing' and year between 2015 and 2025 group by year)

ind_yearly_max.title: Largest yearly payment to the Pacers, 2015-2025
ind_yearly_max.label: b
ind_yearly_max.method: select max(v) from (select year, sum(public_nominal_m) v from items where team = 'IND' and kind = 'ongoing' and year between 2015 and 2025 group by year)

mia_ongoing.title: County and state payments to the Kaseya Center's operator, documented
mia_ongoing.label: b/a
mia_ongoing.method: select sum(public_2026_m) from items where team = 'MIA' and kind = 'ongoing'

nop_ongoing.title: Louisiana stadium district payments to the Pelicans, documented
nop_ongoing.label: b/a
nop_ongoing.method: select sum(public_2026_m) from items where team = 'NOP' and kind = 'ongoing'

threats_counted.title: Explicit or implied relocation threats by owners or the league
threats_counted.label: a
threats_counted.method: select v from comparison where k = 'episodes_explicit_or_implied'

threats_same_city.title: Threats followed by public money in the same city
threats_same_city.label: a
threats_same_city.method: select v from comparison where k = 'same_city_money.n'

threats_team_left.title: Threats after which the team left
threats_team_left.label: a
threats_team_left.method: select v from comparison where k = 'team_left.n'

lag_median.title: Median months from a threat to the approval of public money
lag_median.label: a
lag_median.method: select v from comparison where k = 'lag_median'

lag_n.title: Threats with dated approvals in the same city
lag_n.label: a
lag_n.method: select v from comparison where k = 'lag_months.n'

lag_within_24.title: Of those, approvals within 24 months
lag_within_24.label: a
lag_within_24.method: select v from comparison where k = 'lag_within_24'

threat_deals_n.title: Deals that followed a threat
threat_deals_n.label: a
threat_deals_n.method: select v from comparison where k = 'threat.n'

nothreat_deals_n.title: Deals with no threat
nothreat_deals_n.label: a
nothreat_deals_n.method: select v from comparison where k = 'no_threat.n'

threat_median_share.title: Median public share of deals that followed a threat
threat_median_share.label: a
threat_median_share.method: select 100 * v from comparison where k = 'threat.median_share'

nothreat_median_share.title: Median public share of deals with no threat
nothreat_median_share.label: a
nothreat_median_share.method: select 100 * v from comparison where k = 'no_threat.median_share'

threat_median_public.title: Median public money in deals that followed a threat
threat_median_public.label: a
threat_median_public.method: select v * (select factor_2026 from cpi where year = 2025) from comparison where k = 'threat.median_public_m_2025'

nothreat_median_public.title: Median public money in deals with no threat
nothreat_median_public.label: a
nothreat_median_public.method: select v * (select factor_2026 from cpi where year = 2025) from comparison where k = 'no_threat.median_public_m_2025'

p_share.title: Chance of a difference in public share at least this large if threats made no difference
p_share.label: a
p_share.method: select v from comparison where k = 'p_share'

p_dollars.title: The same test for public money
p_dollars.label: a
p_dollars.method: select v from comparison where k = 'p_dollars'

leases_by_2036.title: Current arena leases that end by 2036
leases_by_2036.label: a
leases_by_2036.method: select count(*) from leases where term_end_year <= 2036

leases_by_2031.title: Leases that end by 2031
leases_by_2031.label: a
leases_by_2031.method: select count(*) from leases where term_end_year <= 2031

first_lease_end.title: Year the first current lease ends
first_lease_end.label: a

okc_exit_penalty.title: Oklahoma City's early-exit penalties
okc_exit_penalty.label: c
okc_exit_penalty.method: Entered by hand; confirmed against data/authorities/lease_clock.csv (team=OKC, column outs_penalties_notes: "more than $1B")

mil_exit_penalty.title: Milwaukee's non-relocation damages in the first year of the lease
mil_exit_penalty.label: c
mil_exit_penalty.method: Entered by hand; confirmed against data/authorities/lease_clock.csv (team=MIL, column outs_penalties_notes: "at least $553M in year 1")

ind_exit_penalty.title: What the Pacers owe if they stop playing home games at the Fieldhouse
ind_exit_penalty.label: b
ind_exit_penalty.method: Entered by hand; confirmed against data/authorities/lease_clock.csv (team=IND, column outs_penalties_notes: "up to $750M")

cpi_base.title: 2026 CPI-U base (January-August average)
cpi_base.label: b/a
cpi_base.method: select cpi from cpi where year = 2026

sources_government.title: Government sources
sources_government.label: a
sources_government.method: select count(*) from sources where origin = 'government'

sources_court.title: Court sources
sources_court.label: a
sources_court.method: select count(*) from sources where origin = 'court'

sources_team.title: Team or league sources
sources_team.label: a
sources_team.method: select count(*) from sources where origin = 'team_or_league'

sources_independent.title: Independent sources
sources_independent.label: a
sources_independent.method: select count(*) from sources where origin = 'independent'
